prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic couture portrait on a grand staircase with a voluminous royal-blue satin ballgown.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional brunette woman with long straight hair, elegant facial structure, voluminous royal-blue satin ballgown, off-shoulder neckline, fitted bodice with secure coverage, flowing skirt with a controlled slit, black strappy heels, and sparkling wide gemstone choker.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 high-angle portrait, subject seated centrally on carpeted marble steps with one leg crossed, arms relaxed on the step behind, ornate baroque runner, beige stone, and wrought-iron railing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm cinematic interior lighting, soft ambient occlusion, highlights on blue satin folds, royal opulent Vogue-like mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-fidelity portrait, sharp fabric folds, realistic skin and jewelry, restrained HDR, 8K detail, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic 9:16 high-angle couture portrait of a clearly adult fictional brunette woman seated centrally on a grand carpeted staircase, voluminous royal-blue satin ballgown with off-shoulder neckline, secure fitted bodice and controlled skirt slit, black strappy heels, wide sparkling gemstone choker, one leg crossed, warm cinematic lighting, beige stone steps, ornate baroque runner and wrought-iron railing, rich satin texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, uncontrolled thigh exposure, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
